subject: Re: FinexCo discovery — next steps & trial setup
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finexco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2024-11-05T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: FinexCo discovery — next steps & trial setup

Hi Samir —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today’s discovery and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Key pain: unpredictable token costs and latency spikes on batch inference for their customer support reranking workload.
- Success metric you mentioned: reduce per-request cost by ~40% while keeping median latency under 250ms for 99th percentile traffic.
- Proposed Redwood approach: dedicate a quantized LLM variant for reranking + prefix KV caching and a short-lived dedicated pool during peak daily windows.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll open a 30–45 minute technical kickoff to provision your trial tenant and walk through the sample integration (I’ve attached a one-page MAP and a very short trial checklist).
2) You grant us a test dataset (or we can use a synthetic sample) and provide a technical contact for the SSO/K8s/network bits if you want a VPC trial.
3) We’ll schedule a follow-up to review early telemetry and tune batching/quantization.

Availability for the technical kickoff: Tue 11/12 between 10–12 PT or Wed 11/13 2–4 PT. If those don’t work, tell me what’s best and we’ll adapt.

Attachments: 2024-11-05-FinexCo-MAP.pdf (mutual action plan), trial-checklist.md

Thanks — excited to get you running.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finexco.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2024-11-06T09:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FinexCo discovery — next steps & trial setup

Thanks Priyom — appreciate the clear recap.

Quarter-end is a bit chaotic here, and I need to push some decisions out by a couple weeks. We remain interested — the cost/latency story is compelling. Could we tentatively book the technical kickoff for the week of 11/25? I’m traveling the week of 11/12.

Also, quick question: for the trial tenant do you require production data or can we use a 1–2 day sample extract? I can coordinate a technical lead once I confirm the date.

Samir
Head of AI, FinexCo
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finexco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2024-11-08T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FinexCo discovery — next steps & trial setup

Hey Samir —

Totally understand — thanks for the note. Week of 11/25 works; happy to tentatively book and then lock once your travel calendar clears. For the trial, a 1–2 day sample extract is perfect for initial telemetry — no production PII required.

If it helps, Marissa (cc’d) can run a 20-minute sandbox walkthrough before the kickoff to make the technical kickoff faster. If you prefer, we’ll keep the tentative 11/25 slot and adjust later.

Proposed short windows for the week of 11/25: Tue 11/26 10–11 PT, Wed 11/27 9–11 PT. Tell me what works and I’ll send invites.

If priorities change on your side, a quick note is totally fine — we’ll pause and reschedule when you’re ready.

Best,
Priyom
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finexco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2024-11-20T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Checking in — trial kickoff still on? (quick help to unblock)

Hi Samir —

Wanted to check in as I noticed we haven’t seen activity in the trial tenant that was provisioned the week of 11/12, and the tentative kickoff for the week of 11/25 is approaching. I know things move quickly at quarter-end — two options to make this painless: 

1) Fast path (recommended): Marissa can run a 30–45 minute hands-on setup session (she’ll do the tenant checks, sample integration snippet, and validate KV caching config). She can also flip an ephemeral dedicated pool so you see cost/latency numbers quickly.
2) Pause & reschedule: If FinexCo timelines shifted, tell me a new target week and we’ll hold the tenant and close the loop.

If you prefer, we can also set up a lightweight kickoff with only your engineering manager + Marissa and keep product stakeholders out until you have initial telemetry.

I’ve re-attached the mutual action plan and the short trial checklist to make the pre-kickoff steps trivial.

Attachments: 2024-11-05-FinexCo-MAP.pdf, trial-checklist.md

Would you like me to lock Marissa in for Tue 11/26 10:30 PT, or should I hold off? Quick reply with Y/N (or a preferred date) is perfect.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
